newsitem.title: ESTONIA: ESTONIA-HOIU TO ENTER BALTIC LOAN MARKET.
newsitem.headline: ESTONIA-HOIU TO ENTER BALTIC LOAN MARKET.

text.p: Hoiupank said on Monday it is considering launching loan projects in the other Baltic countries and has already received applications from companies outside Estonia.
Hoiupank's loan department head Aivar Rehe told Reuters some Baltic companies have submitted loan applications to the bank, which may be approved if the talks are successful.
Rehe said the loans would be medium to large but declined to provide any more details.
Rehe said lower interest rates in Estonia were the main reason why Latvian and Lithuanian companies were looking north for credit sources.

The short-term average loan interest rate in Estonia was 9.6 percent in June compared to 13.86 percent in Latvia. Estonia's long-term interest rates were at 11.5 percent in average in June compared to 12.25 percent in Latvia.
Hoiupank is one of the largest commercial banks in Estonia.
